title: Xulio Golden Protector
description: A full-body illustration of a young man with dark skin and short black hair, standing with arms outstretched. He wears ornate red and gold armor with flame motifs, a golden sun emblem on his chest, a flowing golden sash, and matching greaves, while holding two flaming swords with both hands extended to the sides.
prompt: A young dark-skinned male warrior with short black hair stands centered against a solid green background with arms outstretched horizontally. He wears elaborate red and gold fantasy armor featuring a radiant sun emblem on the chest, flame patterns, a golden sash tied at the waist, and ornate golden greaves. He holds two flaming swords with both hands extended, flames licking the blades. He has a serious expression and wears a golden crown-like headpiece with flame details.
